name: Orbital Drift
storyline:
As a member of a new scientific expedition, you arrive on the planet Tauris b hoping for groundbreaking
discoveries. Instead of answers, you find chaos. The previous colonists – without warning – attack your
group. You barely escape with your life.
Fleeing into orbit brings no relief. While drifting around the planet, you begin to uncover that the attack was
not random. Older researchers are desperately trying to conceal a dark truth about the destruction of a
civilization that once inhabited Tauris b.
You orbit the planet alone, repairing damaged satellites and exploring forgotten asteroids. Each new
fragment of information brings you closer to the truth – and to a decision that cannot be undone.
Warn humanity? Transmit a signal from the mysterious asteroid? Or destroy it – or become the new guardian
of knowledge about the creation of life?
summary: Explore drifting wrecks orbiting a dead planet. Master orbital mechanics. Fight zero gravity in space. Gather resources and build modules. Upgrade your ship to travel further. Uncover a civilization’s downfall. Are people on Earth ready to learn its history?
